Name: Amaziah, Son of Joash
Summary: Son of Joash in the kingly line of Judah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:12: Son of Joash in the kingly line of Judah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Amaziah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
